purpose: Public content-hash manifest for the FTS artifact. Records, per file, both the digest of the PUBLISHED bytes and the digest of the INTERNAL original, plus a 'scrubbed' flag. Data files carrying institutional infrastructure identifiers (API hostname, gateway routing prefixes on model ids) are emptied/stripped before release, so those files differ byte-wise from the internal originals by design; every scientific field -- conditions, outcomes, counts, scenario ids -- is untouched. Scripts, preregistrations and scored summaries are byte-identical unless flagged.
